title: Ep 49 — Salesforce's Agent Obeys a Web Form, Replit Takes Payments, and the One-Prompt Cinematic Website at Twenty-Three Thousand a Month
description: A thin weekend for first-party news, so the episode focuses on agents trusting what they read: Salesforce's SalesBleed flaws let hidden instructions in a public web form steer Agentforce, Meta's Muse agent had a flaw exposing users' cloud machines, and Replit's agent gains Airwallex payments and Claude Opus five point five. The build is Draftly, a one-founder prompt-to-cinematic-scroll-website tool verified at about twenty three thousand dollars a month, reworked as Big Moment Pages for draw launches, charger switch-ons and season launches.
